scientific_integrity: Unrestricted proof is structural; finite checker independently tests definitions and selected small cases. Prior nonequivariant and Euler results are acknowledged, not attributed as new.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected simple bipartite graphs and color-exchanging involutions; exact one-dimensional fixed-point PL model only for robust parameter three. The universal target must be a finite connected graph. Independent external validation has not been performed.
title: Universal connected graph fixed loci of three-robust clique complexes
